column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- ipl: the GRAPHICS PROGRAMS of the Icon Program Library, out of the published denominator, one row per unit:
# name<TAB>NEEDS_GRAPHICS_FACILITY<TAB>evidence. LON'S WORD, 2026-09-27, in-chat to hq_icon, verbatim: "Place the graphics programs on the exclude list."
# THE TEST, MEASURED NOT READ: a unit is a graphics program when its own source or its link closure (procs/, gprocs/) calls a graphics
# built-in -- the 48 names the function() of an iconx 9.5.25a built with X-Configure lists beyond the installed NoGraphics oracle's
# (Active Alert Bg Clip Clone Color ColorValue CopyArea ... WAttrib WDefault WFlush WriteImage WSync) -- or opens a window. A unit
# that only links a graphics library and runs without reaching it stays in the denominator as fixture work: the seven procs/ variant
# translator skeletons that UNGRADABLE.tsv had filed with the graphics rows run under the NoGraphics oracle and fail on Mp/init/program
# (supplied by generated code), so they are UNGRADED NEEDS_DRIVER, not excluded. An excluded unit is still shipped and still sits in its
# UNGRADABLE bucket (ORACLE_CONTRACT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED); the row reads pass / (shipped - containers - excluded) with Excl named.
# 182 rows (measured 2026-09-27 on corpus with the classifier in hq_icon's scratch; re-derive, never trust this count).

# 2026-11-17 (the cto, ruling on officer_07's measurement): the 149 gprogs rows are class GRADED_IN_ANOTHER_PACKAGE, each naming the package and the entry that grades the program; the 33 gprocs rows stay NEEDS_GRAPHICS_FACILITY, library files with no main for the library-driver rows.
# TERMINAL AND NETWORK PROGRAMS (Lon 2026-10-03, in-chat to hq_icon, verbatim: "You can have terminal and network test programs marked as excluded."): class NEEDS_TERMINAL is a unit
# whose function is to drive an interactive terminal (cursor addressing, termcap, ANSI control, single-key reads, /dev/tty) and class NEEDS_NETWORK a unit whose function is to talk to a

# network peer (HTTP); a graded run has neither a terminal nor a peer. Each row's evidence is the unit's own purpose and the oracle's verdict. 17 rows (14 NEEDS_TERMINAL, 3 NEEDS_LOADFUNC), measured 2026-10-03.

# THE 19 TERMINAL PROGRAMS (Lon 2026-10-03 13:1x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "Exclude the 19 terminal programs."; CEO-1471) AS REFINED (Lon 13:2x CDT, verbatim: "Certainly we can conjure some data files for any test that might need input."; CEO-1472):

# a unit the oracle refuses only for a missing input is conjured and graded, never excluded; only a unit that needs a terminal device (stty, termcap, /dev/tty, single-key getch and kbhit reads), a Macintosh or the network stays here. Of the 19: graded with conjured fixtures

# fuzz headicon hotedit newicon verse genfile isize; excluded NEEDS_TERMINAL bj snake hcal4unx yahtz post reply lister listviz hebeng krieg (and missile); owed a conjured transcript hr; ungradable when (the host's ls format).

# LOADFUNC (Lon 2026-10-03 13:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "Move the loadfunc feature until later, so exclude those tests."; CEO-1470): class NEEDS_LOADFUNC, a unit whose own run loads a C function through loadfunc, MEASURED by the loader's trace of the oracle's run opening libcfunc.so: vhttp, htget, weblinks. The ifncs, io and iftrace drivers never open it and stay graded.
